reasons: The selector uses otel_metric_type="gauge", but postgresql.tup_inserted is a monotonic sum in the dataset (dataset_types: sum), so the selector matches no series. It should be otel_metric_type="sum".

The $db template variable (prefix db) should become a matcher on postgresql_database_name=~"$db", and the $host variable (prefix host) should become host_name=~"$host" (host_name is observed in the dataset). The candidate drops both, so it covers a wider set of series than the Datadog request.
The $scope variable has no prefix and default '*', so dropping it is correct. The $table variable is not used in the query, so it does not apply.

Quantity (tuple insertions) and grouping by database name match the Datadog request, and rate() on a monotonic sum is the right treatment. The outcome is translated, which is correct because a direct OTel metric exists.
